title: Sichuan Cheese Pancakes
description: A twist on traditional Chinese cheese pancakes with a Sichuan flair. The infused cheese adds a unique flavor.
instructions: Combine crushed pie crust and 30g cottage cheese in a bowl.
Mix 60g yogurt and 120g infused cheese together until smooth.
Add the wet mixture to the dry, and stir until well combined.
Gradually add water while stirring until a pancake batter forms.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear.
Flip pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve warm with a dipping sauce of your choice.
